scope: Dataset necessary-condition audit plus direct phase optimization; no neural network training.
operator: project single-FFT Fresnel, 128x128, uniform unit input amplitude, output amplitude/max, uint8 phase PNG roundtrip

train.note: Necessary condition only. Does not give a Pearson/SSIM ceiling or optimizer convergence guarantee.

validation.note: Necessary condition only. Does not give a Pearson/SSIM ceiling or optimizer convergence guarantee.

limitations: Necessary-condition violation rules out exact target matching; passing is not a certificate.
Does not establish an upper bound for Pearson or SSIM.
Direct optimization on four validation quartets is not a full-validation model result.
Architecture restriction and saturation contributions cannot be measured without the trained checkpoint.
